notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at الأعمش (named in both); the tail إبراهيم، همام، حذيفة is written once and belongs to both.
Hudhayfa is the last link: the saying is his (فقال حذيفة ... سمعت رسول الله), so he is the Companion link after Hammam (rule 6).
«واللفظ له» is an editor gloss and is left out.
